{"text":"Create a comprehensive design system for "GreenFlow" - a health-focused smoothie 
and nutritious food app. The design system should:

FOUNDATION:
- Color Palette: Organic, natural tones (sage green, earthy browns, fresh citrus 
  accents, cream white). Include primary, secondary, accent, semantic (success/error) 
  and neutral colors with full contrast ratios for accessibility (WCAG AA minimum)
- Typography: 2-3 font families (1 for headings, 1 for body). Include scales for 
  H1-H6, body, labels, captions with line heights and letter spacing
- Spacing System: 8px base grid (8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64px increments)
- Border Radius: Consistent rounded corners (2px, 4px, 8px, 16px) for organic feel
- Elevation/Shadows: 3-4 shadow scales for depth without harshness

COMPONENT LIBRARY:
- Buttons (primary, secondary, tertiary + sizes: small, medium, large)
- Cards (recipe cards, nutrition info cards, user testimonial cards)
- Input Fields (text, search, number inputs with focus states)
- Toggles & Switches (for dietary preferences)
- Progress Indicators (hydration tracker, nutrition goals)
- Navigation (bottom nav, top bar, breadcrumbs)
- Tags & Badges (dietary labels: vegan, gluten-free, etc.)
- Modals & Alerts (success, warning, error states)
- Forms (ingredient selector, goal-setting wizard)

INTERACTION STATES:
- Default, Hover, Active, Disabled, Loading, Error for all interactive elements
- Micro-interactions: smooth transitions, clear feedback

DOCUMENTATION:
- Usage guidelines for each component
- Do's and Don'ts
- Accessibility notes
- Spacing examples
- Real-world application examples in app screens","providerOptions":{}}

{"text":"Now I understand the issue. `index.css` imports:
1. `fonts.css` (which has the Google Fonts `@import`)
2. `tailwind.css`
3. `theme.css` (which also has `@import "./fonts.css"` at the top)

When PostCSS/Vite processes these, it inlines everything. The `@import` in `theme.css` ends up after Tailwind's CSS content (which is a lot of CSS), causing the error "postcss: @import must precede all other statements".

The fix is simple: remove the `@import "./fonts.css"` from `theme.css`. 

For the second issue, there's a duplicate `borderBottom` key in the object literal in PatternsSection.tsx that I need to remove.","providerOptions":{}}
